thread:
marisol: FYI ACME opened a P1 — p99 went from ~600ms to 3.2s around 04:12 UTC. They report API timeouts and occasional 503s. I see OOMs on gpu-serve-42 and 'slab eviction' logs. Raising here for triage.
aya: ack, looking. can you paste the request IDs or example trace?
marisol: sent two request IDs in the ticket: req_8f3a and req_8f3b. customer says this started right after a deploy ~04:09 UTC.
deploy-bot: Deployment completed: inference-runtime v2.14 -> prod (04:10:12 UTC).
aya: pulling logs from gpu-serve-42 now. preliminary: repeated KV cache growth for tenant=acme-inc, KV size spikes ~2.6x then allocations fail.
observability-bot: Metric alert: tenant.acme-inc.kv_bytes_out > 90th percentile at 04:11:30 UTC -> p99 latency increased. Link: https://obs.redwood/alerts/ACME-1823
samir: sounds like KV growth + fragmentation causing GPU OOMs and long GC/evictions -> p99. did we change allocator behavior in v2.14?
jordan: v2.14 did flip allocator tunings for small-slab reuse (PR #482). it reduced churn in most tests but may increase slab density for certain seq-len distributions.
aya: stack trace snippet from gpu-serve-42:
```
E 04:12:07 AllocFailure: alloc(1.2G) failed, slab_avail=800M, slabs_free=3
W 04:12:08 KVCache: tenant=acme-inc entries=1.2M bytes=3.1G growth=+1.8G/5m
I 04:12:09 SlabEvict: evicted=128MB, latency=280ms
```
marisol: customer sample: long multi-turn prompts (16k tokens) plus embedding calls interleaved; might be triggering large KV growth.
samir: immediate mitigations: 1) route acme traffic to fallback CPU pool; 2) throttle concurrent token windows for tenant; 3) if proven, rollback v2.14.
aya: can we enable fallback routing for acme from routing policy? which policy id?
jordan: policy acme-fallback-2024 exists. I can flip it to prefer cpu-mid instances and lower batch size.
marisol: please do that and notify customer. prefer a quick mitigation before rollback.
jordan: done — flipped routing at 04:25 UTC to cpu-mid preference and reduced batch_size=8 for acme. :white_check_mark:
observability-bot: Routing change applied. New route: acme-inc -> cpu-mid (pref),fallback:gpu-low.
aya: monitoring heatmap: after routing flip p99 dropped to ~950ms at 04:29 UTC but we still see occasional OOMs on stale gpu pods.
samir: schedule drain on gpu-serve-42 and repro measurements: `kubectl cordon gpu-serve-42 && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then restart pods. also capture `nvidia-smi` and allocator stats before restart.
aya: cordoned and drained at 04:33 UTC. restarted runtime pods; observed allocator free list compaction in logs, p99 returned to ~650ms by 04:38 UTC.
marisol: customer update: told them we mitigated (routing + drain) and actively investigating root cause, provided ETA for rollback if regressions persist. customer appreciative but wants repro checklist.
samir: root cause hypothesis: allocator tuning in v2.14 increases slab packing for many small allocations -> when long context requests cause KV growth, fragmentation prevents satisfying large contiguous allocations -> OOM -> long eviction cycles -> tail latency. KV growth amplified by mixed embedding + generation workload pattern.
aya: repro steps I used against staging to reproduce pattern:
```
# reproduce KV growth pattern
for i in seq 1 200; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/realtime \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_KEY" \
    -d '{"prompt":"<16k multi-turn payload>", "stream":false}' &
  sleep 0.3
done
# monitor /metrics tenant_kv_bytes, allocator_stats
```
marisol: recommended longer-term mitigations: add tenant-level max_kv_bytes, enable proactive slab compaction on high-alloc spikes, and provide per-tenant fallback throttles. also add an alert if kv growth rate > X MB/min.
jordan: I'll open infra ticket to revert the small-slab packing flip for runtime builds until we validate on mixed workloads.
samir: as intermediate engineering mitigation, we can add allocator backpressure: deny new large contiguous allocations and force early eviction for cold KVs. toggles should be runtime flags.
aya: recording repro artifacts: heap histograms + nvidia-smi snapshots uploaded to /artifacts/ACME-1819876543.
marisol: action items: 1) notify customer (done), 2) monitor for 24h and rollback v2.14 if p99 > 1.2s persists, 3) infra ticket to rollback packer flag, 4) product to spec tenant_kv_limits.
marisol: closing loop: rollback remains on table. keep this channel updated. :handshake:
